Monthly Overdoses in Utah and Salt Lake Counties

Source: R/data.R
overdoses.Rd

A dataset demonstrating monthly overdose counts to be used for testing and visualizing small-number suppression in public health reporting.

Usage

overdoses

Format

A data frame with 40 rows and 3 variables:

county

Name of the county, either Salt Lake or Utah

month_date

Date object representing the first day of the reporting month

count

Integer representing the number of reported cases

Source

Hypothetical demonstration data set.
